title: Mundgod Tibetan Settlement Commemorates 36th Anniversary of the Nobel Peace Prize
summary: The settlement in Mundgod, India observed the 36th anniversary of the Nobel Peace Prize presented to His Holiness the 14th Dalai Lama. His Eminence Kundeling Tatsak Rinpoche attended the celebrations.

title: 21st Founding Anniversary of TCV Chauntra & Visit to Men-Tsee-Khang
summary: His Eminence attended the 21st founding anniversary of Chauntra Tibetan Children's Village School and visited the Men-Tsee-Khang Pharmaceutical Department.

title: Rinpoche Meets Rector of Meritxell Basilica & Andorran Health Minister
summary: His Eminence held a diplomatic meeting with the rector of Meritxell Basilica and the Andorran Health Minister in Andorra.

title: Teaching Visit to European Dharma Centres
summary: His Eminence completed a teaching tour across European Dharma centres, giving teachings on Lamrim and the Stages of the Path.

title: Annual Prayers at Kundeling Monastery
summary: The annual prayer ceremonies were held at Kundeling Monastery in Mundgod with the participation of monks and devotees.

title: Visit to Ladakh for Teaching Engagements
summary: His Eminence visited Ladakh for a series of teaching engagements, blessing ceremonies, and meetings with local communities.
